root_cause.text: The BPF JIT buffer allocation requested only 4-byte alignment instead of 8-byte alignment, causing the `u64 target` field in `struct bpf_plt` to potentially be misaligned and subject to non-atomic torn reads on ARM64.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `bpf_jit_binary_pack_alloc` call in `arch/arm64/net/bpf_jit_comp.c` to pass `sizeof(u64)` instead of `sizeof(u32)`, addressing the CVE description which states that 64-bit loads/stores on ARM64 are only guaranteed to be single-copy atomic if 64-bit aligned, and the previous 4-byte alignment allowed base addresses (e.g., ending in 0x4 or 0xc) that failed to align the `target` field correctly.
